title: Inventory: Gatbonton et al. 2006 (PLoS Genet 2:e35) supporting information and table images
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/gatbonton2006/raw/`. Fetched from journals.plos.org with plain requests:
the supporting files (Figure S1 `sg001`, Table S1 `st001`) and the article's table images (`t001`, `t002`) and the correction's
table image (PLoS Genet 2:e104, `journal.pgen.0020104.t001`). PLOS sends no file names, so extensions were set from the file type.
The article and correction pages are `../article.html` and `../correction.html`. Checksums are in `MANIFEST.tsv`.
Text extractions used by the ingest are in `../extracted/` (made by `extract.py`).

roles.journal.pgen.0020035.sg001.tif: Figure S1. TLM genes affect senescence rate independently of the RAD52 recombination pathway (figure only).
roles.journal.pgen.0020035.st001.xls: Table S1. Candidate telomere length-control genes in the BY × RM11 cross: genes in the chromosome 12 and 13 regions with function, telomere phenotype or essentiality, and amino-acid differences in RM11.
roles.journal.pgen.0020035.t001.tif: Table 1 (image): genes whose deletion affects telomere length and their interaction with the telomerase pathway. Incomplete as published; see the correction.
roles.journal.pgen.0020035.t002.tif: Table 2 (image): loci that control telomere length in RM and BY strains. Not read off the image.

missing: No table of QTL positions or intervals: Table 2 is an image, so the two QTL are ingested by chromosome from the text.
No genotype or phenotype data; the deletion-strain blots are referred to an external lab page (fhcrc.org), not fetched.
